title: Don't Buy!
text: Don't Buy!. I've written a review already. The lids do not fit on the containers, so it doesn't close all the way.

product_metadata.title: Ziploc® Plastic Food Storage Container Set, Clear, Pack Of 3
features: Keep your lunch, dinner or leftovers fresh with Ziploc storage containers. These plastic food storage containers are safe for use in the microwave, dishwasher and freezer.
Take with you on the go when working in the office or anywhere else.
Use as directed in microwave, freezer and dishwasher.
Includes 3 extra-small squares, 2 small rectangles, 1 small square and 1 medium square.
Wide rim, finger grips and a ridged lid make handling easy.
